card.title: Thunder Lizard Armory
card.pitch: A pixel dragon forge announces its arrival, then arms up to two heroes with dragon gear that fires lightning-bolt shots.
card.visualHook: A little dragon-shaped forge flashes before chunky pixel lightning starts flying.
acceptance: Automatically show the custom dragon forge and a lightning telegraph within 30 ticks of deploy.
After 60 more ticks, equip up to two available heroes with the custom dragon weapon; its projectile uses a lightning-bolt sprite.
Show a brief lightning-and-ring aftermath by tick 180. A raid or !dragon can repeat the sequence with a 30-second cooldown.
If no heroes are present, the forge and effects still appear; equip eligible heroes on a later activation.
card.feasibility: Define a dragon prop, hero weapon and projectile; use bounded hero queries, equip, scheduled effects and raid/command callbacks.
card.risk: Low: equip at most two heroes per activation; use ordinary bounded weapon damage.
